title: CILIATE: Towards Fairer Class-based Incremental Learning by Dataset and Training Refinement
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. It focuses on technical fairness metrics like Class-wise Variance (CWV) and Maximum Class-wise Discrepancy (MCD) in the context of class-based incremental learning for image classification.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith.
